learning_outcomes.text: Have a basic knowledge of relevant concepts, theories, models, methods, and tools in project management, organization, and governance throughout the entire project process.
Be able to apply relevant concepts, theories, models, methods, and tools to various types of projects, for example through case descriptions.
Be able to motivate and reflect on project models and methods based on the project context, prerequisites, and types of industrial projects.

syllabus_topics: Concepts, theories, and models for the management, organization, and governance of projects.
Methods and tools for project initiation, planning, execution, control, and termination.
teaching_methods: Application of project methods in assignments
assessment_rules: Grades for examination modules are decided in accordance with the assessment criteria presented at the start of the course. The grading scale is U, 3, 4, 5.
bibliography: Tonnquist, Bo, (2024) Project management. Sixth edition Stockholm : Sanoma Utbildning, [2024] ISBN: 9789152366295
Scientific articles may be added in connection with project work.
degree: Industrial Engineering and Management - International (6CIEI), terms 1-6 (first cycle)
